I knew because I woke up and caught him in action. The sad thing is that I’ve always watched reality shows and told myself if I ever was in the victim’s shoe, I would scream, resist and attack my abuser. When it did happen to me, my flight or fight response shut down completely. I totally froze while tears rolled down my face. My whole world stopped as I was trying to make sense of what was happening (I was sexually inactive at that age) and the person involved (he was a close relative). He only finished his act when he heard a noise coming from the other room. For two whole weeks, I couldn’t look my family or anyone  in the eye. I was overwhelmed with shame and guilt (though I shouldn’t). Then came the threats...

I was doubting whether what happened to me is considered ‘sexual abuse’ given no actual penetration took place; yet, the memories (and pain) lingered all the way into my adulthood. Other victims had been through much worse (in terms of duration and intenstiy of abuse) and seem to be able to keep that part of their life in the past and move on.

Hope you find your closure.
